docs.cv:
Samuel Achterberg-Osei
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer | Azure | Terraform | DevOps
[EMAIL] | [PHONE] | [LINKEDIN]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Cloud infrastructure engineer with hands-on experience designing and operating Azure infrastructure, developing Terraform modules, and automating application deployments with Azure DevOps. Experienced with Azure networking, AKS operations, Azure IaaS migrations, and PowerShell automation. Azure Administrator Associate and Terraform Associate certified.

CORE SKILLS
Cloud and infrastructure: Microsoft Azure, Azure IaaS, Azure landing zones, Terraform, Azure Migrate
Networking and security: Hub-spoke networks, VNets, VNet peering, Azure Firewall, private endpoints, private DNS, site-to-site VPN, Microsoft 365 security baselines, Entra ID
DevOps and platforms: Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, AKS operations, Docker, Helm, App Service, drift detection
Automation and systems: PowerShell, Windows and Linux servers, VMware, Proxmox
Testing: Terratest (Go)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Cloud Engineer (Contract) | Havenstad Logistics | 2025-Present
- Build and maintain Azure landing zone infrastructure, Terraform modules, Azure DevOps pipelines, and AKS environments.
- Designed a hub-spoke network across three subscriptions, including Azure Firewall, private DNS zones, private endpoints for storage and SQL, and VNet peering.
- Added Terratest module tests to the pipeline and a nightly infrastructure drift-detection job.
- Replaced manual deployments for 15 internal .NET and Node applications with Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for build, test, and deployment to App Service or AKS.
- Increased deployment frequency from roughly monthly to several times per week for most applications.
- Operate AKS upgrades, node pools, and ingress; application manifests are owned by the development teams.

Freelance IT Support | 2022-2023
- Created a repeatable PowerShell script and checklist for small-business Microsoft 365 security baselines.
- Supported implementation of MFA, Conditional Access, mailbox auditing, and backups for small clients.

Systems Administrator | Maasbrug Gemeente IT Services | 2014-2020
- Administered Windows and Linux servers and VMware infrastructure for a municipal IT department.
- Planned and executed the migration of 60 servers from VMware to Azure IaaS using Azure Migrate.
- Completed cutover over six weekends with no unplanned downtime.
- Used Azure VMs, VNets, site-to-site VPN, and PowerShell in the migration.
- Automated repetitive administration tasks with PowerShell.

CAREER BREAK AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
Family caregiving | March 2020-August 2022
- Took time away from paid work to provide full-time care for my father.
- Kept Azure Administrator Associate knowledge current and provided unpaid IT help to my church and family.

Professional development | February 2024-February 2025
- Completed a part-time, online, English-language cloud bootcamp in December 2024.
- Studied Terraform and built a Proxmox homelab.

CERTIFICATIONS
Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (2025)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor role supporting Corvale Mobility’s fleet connectivity platform. My recent work combines Azure infrastructure engineering, Terraform, and deployment automation—experience I can bring to building and operating the cloud foundations for services connecting the new train fleet with backend systems.

At Havenstad Logistics, I designed a Terraform-based Azure hub-spoke network across three subscriptions, including Azure Firewall, private DNS, private endpoints, and VNet peering. I added Terratest module tests and nightly drift detection. I also replaced manual deployments for 15 internal applications with Azure DevOps pipelines for build, test, and deployment to App Service or AKS, increasing deployment frequency from roughly monthly to several times per week for most applications. I operate AKS upgrades, node pools, and ingress, working alongside development teams that own the application manifests.

Earlier, I planned and executed the migration of 60 VMware servers to Azure IaaS, completing the cutover over six weekends with no unplanned downtime. My experience with cloud networking, infrastructure as code, practical Microsoft 365 security controls, and reliable deployment processes is relevant to Corvale’s goal of taking fleet connectivity infrastructure from design through production. I am particularly interested in the role’s combination of infrastructure design and operational responsibility for a new generation of trains.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my Azure and Terraform experience could contribute to Corvale’s platform. Thank you for your consideration.

Kind regards,
Samuel Achterberg-Osei
